summary: Full backend + UI verification of the super-admin-only Storage & DB admin tab. 12 pytest cases (only 1 spurious xdist race failure that passes on re-run) plus Playwright UI walkthrough. All destructive flows on the seeded throwaway data (qa_throwaway collection + qa-test-asset orphan) worked; audit trail captured every action; ops-webhook save/get/test/clear cycle works; access control confirmed (demo user gets 401/403 on /api/admin/db/overview).

GET /api/admin/db/overview lists collections; users row has protected=true
POST /api/admin/db/backup succeeded (mongodump available), stamp appears in /api/admin/db/backups
POST /api/admin/storage/delete-orphans deleted the seeded qa-test-asset (total_count decreased by 1, orphan owner no longer present)

UI: admin-tab-storage visible for super admin, all data-testids render: storage-db-tab, ops-webhook-section, ops-webhook-test/enabled/platform, db-section, db-collection-users (with PROTECTED badge), db-browse-qa_throwaway, db-purge-qa_throwaway, db-backups-section, db-backup-btn, storage-section, audit-section (4 audit rows)
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: pytest-xdist runs tests in parallel and TestAudit assertion for 'db_purge' can race with TestPurgeThrowaway on the other worker. Not a product bug — audit trail is correct when queried after purge. Consider @pytest.mark.serial or dependency ordering if future flakiness matters.
Consider: POST /api/admin/ops-webhook/test with 400 when url empty is fine, but frontend already guards via 'save first'.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded qa_throwaway (3 docs) and orphan asset qa-test-asset (owner qa-fake-user-zzz). Both consumed by destructive tests as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working. Note that after this run the qa_throwaway collection is empty (still exists) and the qa-test-asset orphan is gone. If destructive tests need to run again, re-seed those items first. The ops-webhook has been cleared back to empty/disabled per instructions.
